image_description: A blue and white striped fabric baby bib lying flat on a neutral beige surface. The bib features a curved neck opening with a red snap fastener at the top center. It has a rounded, shield-like body shape with visible stitching along the edges. There is a small embroidered detail or patch on the lower right side and a triangular fabric fold or pocket detail near the center.
